query:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaderboard_entries
                   WHERE board = ?1 AND period_key = ?2 AND score > ?3)
                + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaderboard_entries
                   WHERE board = ?1 AND period_key = ?2 AND score = ?3
                     AND (achieved_at, subject_id) < (?4, ?5)) AS "n!: i64"
